snippet.title: PICK-A-BOO Trailer
snippet.description:
オンライン最大6人で協力可能なローグライク・マルチ脱出アクションゲーム「PICK A BOO」のSteam next festトレーラーをチェックしよう！

プレイヤーは「夜逃げ引っ越し業者」の人形となり、処分される運命にある仲間を救うため、危険なステージへ潜入します。磁力で家具や荷物を集め、敵の追跡をかわしながら、トラックへの積み込みと脱出を目指すことが目的。
「PICK A BOO」はSteamにて近日登場として公開中。ぜひウィッシュリスト登録をしてください！
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4459600/PICK_A_BOO/

Check out the Steam Next Fest trailer for "PICK A BOO," an online roguelike multi-escape action game for up to 6 players co-op, published by Game & Co. and developed by Toydium.
Players take on the role of "midnight moving crew" dolls, infiltrating dangerous stages to rescue their friends who are destined to be discarded. Collect furniture and cargo using magnetic force, evade pursuing enemies, and load everything onto the truck to make your escape.
"PICK A BOO" is now listed as Coming Soon on Steam — be sure to add it to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4459600/PICK_A_BOO/
